title: 相同问题，不同答案：超越准确率评估LLM可靠性
summary: 研究发现，LLM在等价改写的问题上频繁改变答案，实例级不稳定性高达23%以上。单次提示的正确性不能代表可靠性，但模型通常至少在一个改写版本上回答正确。提出简单自改写策略可部分恢复潜在知识并提升推理性能。
summary_en: LLMs often change answers under meaning-preserving paraphrases, with instance-level instability over 23%. Single-prompt correctness is a poor reliability indicator, but models usually answer correctly for at least one paraphrase. A simple self-paraphrasing strategy can recover latent knowledge and improve inference.
